patches.summary: Multiplayer reliability, server authority, replays, bot + tutorial, card fixes

notes.text: War Horn now actually grants all your units +1 movement for the rest of the turn.
Fixed clicking a hand card right after playing/discarding another selecting the wrong card.
Fixed duplicate card appearing when the hand exceeds its visible limit.
Refreshing the page during a match now restores the board, hands and turn exactly where you left off.
Moves made while your connection drops are sent when it comes back instead of being lost.
If both Kings fall in the same exchange the match is a draw (crypto stakes are refunded).
War Horn no longer freezes the game — click a card in your hand to discard it. The discard can't be skipped.
Players using different decks no longer go out of sync.
Logged-in players can now rejoin a match after refreshing.
Opponent's card count above their hand no longer smears into overlapping text.
Reconnect grace period increased from 10s to 30s.
Card ATK/DEF badges and rules text now fit inside the card; cards show their real ability text.
King HP is shown as a number under each health bar.
A YOUR TURN / OPPONENT'S TURN label sits above a larger END TURN button that no longer overlaps the board.
Guest players get unique names (e.g. Guest-A4B5).
Join by code: press Enter to join, Esc to cancel.
The server now checks every move with its own copy of the game — illegal moves are refused and results can't be faked.
Turn timer: 90 seconds per turn. If time runs out your turn ends automatically; running out three turns in a row forfeits the match.
Matches survive a server restart — both players are reconnected to the same game.
If your game ever goes out of sync it now repairs itself automatically from the server.
Watch Replay: rewatch any finished match from the result screen (pause, 1x, 3x).
Clearer feedback: a message explains why a click did nothing, and a big banner announces each turn.
Losing your own connection no longer shows a fake 'You win' — you get a reload-to-rejoin prompt instead.
Battles started from the lobby now reconnect properly after a network hiccup.
Opponent's cards no longer run off the screen; hovered cards no longer stay on top of the stack.
Practice vs Bot: play an offline match against an AI opponent from the Hub.
Tutorial: a guided first match that walks you through deploying, ending phases, moving and attacking.
War Horn: units with fixed movement patterns (Knight, Scout, Lancer, Messenger, Assassin) reach one square further along each move.
Cancelling a spell's target choice returns the card to your hand and refunds its LEG.
Targeted spells can't be played without a valid target (no more wasted cards).

Coup, Treason and Peasant Revolt now actually work (they did nothing before). Coup captures the target if you have enough LEG left, otherwise banishes it; Treason controls a unit until the end of your turn.
Earthquake no longer freezes the game — click any square to choose its column.
cards can be only placed on the friendly side of the board as always; however new rule; you can only place to a friendly board square if a friendly unit exists in the row that square exists.
let lancer can attack only on the direction it moved, y+ => attack on that direction only. x+ => only on x+ can do attack. Lets remove the property of the lancer that i can only go forward.

unreleased.text: Your hand is now a readable list: cost, name, ATK/DEF and type at a glance. Hover a card for a large preview; cards you can't afford are dimmed.
Hover any unit on the board to see its full card with current stats.
Combat feels punchier: attackers lunge, targets shake, fallen units fade away, new units pop onto the board.
Sound effects for deploying, attacking, deaths, your turn and wins/losses. Toggle with the speaker button or the M key.
Replays show whose turn it is by name and no longer show an END TURN button.
Reconnecting to a match now requires your own account/guest session — a seat can't be taken just by knowing your name.
Practice and tutorial games no longer change your win/loss record; REMATCH after practice starts a new bot game.
Solving a puzzle now actually adds its prize card to your collection.

Fixed a batch of rule bugs found by automated bot-vs-bot testing: Mystic now revives your strongest fallen unit, Casus Belli deploys a unit from your hand, Civil War and Disease last their full duration, Treason returns units correctly.
Ending your turn while a choice is open, or clicking during your opponent's choice, no longer desyncs the match.
Clicking a selected hand card again now really deselects it.
Results are counted exactly once, and the result / lobby screens work every time (not just the first match).
Your hand no longer shows phantom cards when drawing at the hand limit.
Rooms can't be joined, restarted or taken over while a match is running; long matches are no longer cleaned up as stale.
The Hub shows your last match result again.
Practice vs Bot now has three difficulties: Easy, Normal and Hard. Hard weighs trades, keeps its King safe and sets up attacks. Your last choice is remembered.
Lobby INVITE button copies a link; opening it takes your friend straight to the join dialog with the room code filled in.
Crypto stakes and wallet features are paused for MVP 1 — every match is free play.
Puzzles can be solved with a normal account, no wallet needed; the 24 h retry timer is now exact.
The old Quick Play menu was removed — Host / Browse / Join is the one way to play online.
Units no longer briefly 'lose' their square while sliding to a new one (fast turns and 3x replays).
Casus Belli now deploys your unit on the front row of the enemy half, and the unit's On Deploy ability triggers.
Assassin really jumps: 1 step or a 2-square diagonal jump over units; jumping onto an enemy attacks it with no counter.
Village now slows every enemy unit next to it, including Knights, Lancers and Scouts.
Castle only attacks in your LEG phase; Pikeman's ×3 vs Cavalry also applies when it strikes back.
Treason can only steal units, and a stolen unit that dies goes back to its owner's graveyard. Units taken with Coup can't act the turn they're captured.
Card texts updated to match the rules (Scout, King, Disease, Peasant Revolt, Mystic, Militia, Messenger).
Online matches no longer fall out of sync when a card ability triggers (the server now uses exactly the same rules as your game).
